name: Joe Takash
title: President & Founder
bio: Executive facilitator and keynote speaker who, since 1988, has delivered more than 3,500 programs on team alignment, leadership communication, presentation skills, and employee motivation.

name: Sarah Takash
title: Chief Operating Officer
bio: Sarah coordinates integral client alignment in the areas of finances, communication and contractual agreements while Victory's consultants help clients achieve their goals.

name: Ashley Anders
title: Executive Coach and Facilitator
bio: ICF-certified executive coach with more than 25 years of experience across the private and public sectors, including internal leadership development work at Comcast.

name: Brandon Addison
title: Executive Coach and Facilitator
bio: Executive coach, facilitator, and leadership advisor with decades of experience helping high-capacity CEOs, executive teams, and business owners; a PCC-credentialed coach whose clients have included Microsoft, JPMorgan Chase, Thrivent Financial, and Novavax.

name: Calvin Iwema
title: Executive Coach
bio: Seasoned executive coach with over 25 years of experience who has worked individually with well over 500 leaders, from project managers to C-suite executives. Holding an M.A.

name: Carolyn Ferguson
title: Executive Facilitator
bio: A communicator, strategist and trainer (FSMPS, CPSM) who has coached A|E|C teams for 22 years, helping them win project interviews equating to billions in project work.

name: Chad Patterson
title: Executive Coach
bio: Executive leader, coach, speaker, and facilitator with over 25 years of experience who has coached more than 350 leaders and facilitated development experiences for over 500 teams worldwide.

name: Eileen Godinez
title: Executive Coach and Facilitator
bio: Executive coach and organizational development consultant who spent 27 years leading teams herself and now partners with leaders across government, nonprofit, and private-sector organizations; clients include Lyft, UPS, JPMorgan Chase, the Department of Defense, and the IRS.

name: Emma Flack
title: Executive Facilitator and Coach
bio: Executive coach, organizational strategist, and leadership facilitator (EdD, ACC) with 25+ years advising senior teams, from television newsrooms to global boardrooms.

name: Jennifer Nicks
title: Executive Coach
bio: ICF-certified executive coach who has worked with more than 60 individual executives and is certified by UC Berkeley in Accelerating Change Readiness & Agility.

name: Jennifer Pasquale
title: Executive Coach and Facilitator
bio: Facilitator, coach, and organizational development consultant with more than two decades of experience, including 14 years partnering full-time with Quintiles and GlaxoSmithKline on large-scale learning and OD initiatives.

name: Joe Tabers
title: Executive Trainer
bio: Certified Speaking Professional (CSP) and expert in workplace trust, communication and relationships who has worked with over 300 organizations and, since 1985, conducted over 3,000 highly rated programs across more than 45 states and four countries.

name: Kelly Landes
title: Facilitator and Executive Coach
bio: Executive coach, facilitator, and organizational development consultant with more than 20 years of experience. A former licensed psychotherapist, she has coached leaders across 70+ global organizations including Google, Amazon, Visa, Deloitte, and American Express.

name: Laura Dellinger
title: Executive Facilitator and Coach
bio: Executive coach, facilitator, and leadership consultant with more than 30 years of experience, formerly principal and president of a global Certified B-Corp “Best for the World” consultancy.

name: Lauren Zulli
title: Executive Coach and Facilitator
bio: PCC-credentialed executive coach and leadership development expert with 14+ years of experience — and a former sustainability engineer — grounding her work in neuroscience, cognitive behavioral psychology, and evidence-based assessment.

name: Nausheen Farishta
title: Executive Coach and Facilitator
bio: Leadership development consultant, facilitator, and coach with a decade of corporate L&D experience, partnering with Fortune 500 companies, high-growth organizations, and nonprofits.

name: Ravi Rajaratnam
title: Executive Coach and Facilitator
bio: Dr. Ravi Rajaratnam is a seasoned executive and leadership coach with over 30 years of experience across technology, operations, and organizational development — a former CIO and EVP who holds a PhD in Industrial-Organizational Psychology.

name: Saran Traore
title: Executive Coach
bio: Certified executive coach with over 10 years of experience using advanced coaching methodologies and assessments to help leaders and teams build capacity, agility, and resilience.

name: Stephanie Staidle
title: Executive Coach and Facilitator
bio: Licensed therapist (LCAT, ATR-BC), integrative coach, and leadership facilitator with more than 20 years of experience at the intersection of psychology, neuroscience, and business, featured as an expert on ABC, CBS, NBC, and SXSW.

name: Susan Levy
title: Executive Facilitator and Presentation Coach
bio: With a proven record spanning hospitality and Fortune 500 consulting, Susan brings more than two decades of experience in leadership development and executive communication, having facilitated more than 600 programs.

name: Teree Davis
title: Program Manager
bio: Program Manager and operational hub of Victory Consulting, coordinating logistics, materials, and communication so facilitators can focus on delivering impactful experiences and clients have a seamless point of contact.

name: Vaishali Jadhav
title: Executive Facilitator
bio: Seasoned professional with two decades of experience building, scaling, and facilitating global programs for purpose-driven organizations, beginning as a Gallup consultant and later helping found Whole Foods Market's Academy for Conscious Leadership.
